title: 4521-ESP-AGE-21-70-0010 R0
summary:
- This document is an engineering specification for the supply of instruments for a project.
- The scope includes all instruments, cables, gaskets, and manifolds as specified in the main document.
- Supplier must provide a single contact person to monitor material purchases.
- Confidentiality agreements are in place regarding the information contained within this document.
- Alternate billing cycles can be requested by the owner.
- Equipment must meet NEC, IEEE, UL standards.
- Supplier must provide vendor data as promised.
- Quotation must include time for approval drawings and fabrication.
- Equipment is delivered to purchaser's manufacturing site with specific locations.
- Shipment must adhere to a strict delivery schedule finalized at final contract materialization.
- Recommended spare parts list required with prices and delivery details.
- Equipment subject to inspection by Abener Teyma personnel before shipment.
